programme.desc: With spring in full swing, the garden is really starting to flourish, and it’s not just the flowers and trees that are blossoming! Admiring all the colourful flowers, Aaron, Joda and Isla come across some mysterious plants growing from the ground. But what could they be? It’s time to call in Chatterpot!

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: A dusty, old box on the top of the wardrobe is causing sneezing and mayhem. What’s inside? Rebecca and Murphi make a monster from a tissue box, and the Mini Monsters create their own monster glove puppets. Uncle Ernie calls to tell Rebecca about his rare bird photography but is distracted by falling coconuts. Finally, an old sock becomes a fabulous flamingo puppet, with some assistance from the Tiny Helpers.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger encounters an injured Mamma Pea-Rex, who quickly befriends the baby Pea-Rexes.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: At the park, Bluey is struggling to learn how to ride her bike. But as she and Dad watch her friends determination with their own tasks, Bluey is inspired to give it another try.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks, so the Squirrels start to think about what their ambitions might be. Norrie wants to learn how to break dance. Happy has always wanted to jump the famous triple puddle splash. Betty has always wanted to teach Mr Cuddles how to speak Portuguese. Roly has loads, from growing a potato to becoming a pirate. Tag spends a long time thinking what his could be, and then it clicks - he needs to climb over the log! Duggee gets to work helping all of the Squirrels train so they can reach their goals. Duggee teaches them that while it may be hard, the important thing is to keep trying and eventually you’ll get there. The Squirrels achieve their ambitions, and Tag successfully climbs over the log. Now they have achieved their first ambitions, the Squirrels can continue to reach for the stars. And they know Duggee is proud of them no matter what they achieve, and that they should be proud of themselves!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Throw some shapes with King Tiger. What will yours be? Square, triangle, circle, hexagon, heptagon...?

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers go on an early morning walk to spot some cloud shapes. On the way, they see the city waking up, find a funny mirror, spot shapes in the clock tower and even catch a big fish!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Eden and Ava love pretending and make-believe. In this episode, they enjoy a pretend picnic in their bedroom and invent amazing recipes like strawberry stew and vegetable cake! They’re so yummy that Mum gets the hiccups. Later, Eden and Ava build a den for the whole family to hide in. They imagine they’re camping in the woods and look out at the stars. But will they be safe from the noisy tiger in the forest? Roar!

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Aksara is cooking a curry from Sri Lanka which contains a very special ingredient: tamarind paste. Her friends find the taste quite unusual at first, so let’s hope they like it in the finished curry, once it has been cooked with lots of other lovely ingredients. Aksara has so many delicious ingredients to prepare that she has to get her sister to help! Aksara serves the curry in a traditional way – with rice and roti bread, on a banana leaf and with no knives and forks.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In today's episode, Maddie is looking at the way things are made or trained to help us. First, she meets seven-year-old Anu, who uses a prosthetic leg. Maddie visits a workshop where prosthetic limbs are made and finds out how a computer uses 3D images to make a model, then uses her special camera to see how the images are carved into foam. Next, Maddie meets Nano, a special dog that has been trained to detect nuts and warn his owner who has a nut allergy. We learn how a dog's nose is different from our nose and, using a special camera, we see how Nano makes sure a picnic is safe for his owner.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Tinks uses her super fetch skills and big dog energy to help Charli model some upcycled outfits at WUFS – the Woofton Upcycled Fashion Show.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet Inca the jaguar. They get close as she has her breakfast and see her amazingly coloured coat. Most jaguars are yellow and black, but not Inca. She is melanistic, or all black. Their next animal is the anaconda. This giant snake is a sit-and-wait predator. When face to face, they see how it is perfectly adapted to stay submerged and hidden in the water for so long. Finally, Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the wild connection is between these two incredible animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Simon and Waffle are home alone. Simon recalls the first time he met Waffle as a pup, and the pair share memories of the Wonder Dog becoming part of the Brooklyn-Bell family.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Silky’s new friend is a clever clam called Clementine.

programme.title: Yukee

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie, Triggs, Mum and Dad are going for a walk in the countryside, but Dad is adamant that he does not want his pristine hiking shoes to get dirty. Luckily, Maddie and Triggs are on hand to stop their buddy getting muddy!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn the many ways you can walk with the help of friends and a catchy song.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Three does magic tricks with apples to show the others who goes first, who is biggest and how to surprise your number friends. Learn about simple counting, ordering and adding with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: When Alphablock G waters her magic seedling, it grows into a maze surrounding her and her friends. Every turn seems to lead to a dead end. How can they find their way out? They come across signs. The words on them seem tricky but turn out to be helpful. By learning to read NO, GO, GO TO and GO IN, they eventually find the door that leads outside. Hooray! But who is that calling? It’s Alphablock W, who is still lost inside. Confident that they can now read the signs, they dash back in to help him.

programme.title: Something Special

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies swap places in the Tubby Car and drive to the Hidey Hup. They swap places again on the Tubby Uppy Downy before going up and down.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how earthworms play such an important role in the environment. They find out that earthworms keep the soil healthy by digging through it and eating things like dead leaves and twigs, which helps return nutrients to the soil. They learn that earthworms can be food for other animals too. On the way, they dig for worms before watering the plants with nutritious worm juice.

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: Elvis has forgotten his trainers and has to wear a pair with laces, but he can’t tie them without his gran’s help. He needs to quickly learn to tie them himself if he wants to get a PB.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: CBeebies’ very own motorbike rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that can go on water! Grace does some cool tricks on a Hydroflyer, shows off a boat that kind of flies and then sees a shark on an underwater scooter!

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: Dodge isn't in class, and the pups wonder why. Woofer begins to really miss Dodge but hides his feeling from the rest of the class. It's only when Woofer says out loud how he feels that he starts to feel better and discovers the others feel the same way too.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Audrey has a table tennis lesson with her coach Harry. How will Audrey do?

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Pearl’s glacier discovery triggers a pika rescue, an algae feast and a water stoppage.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Sammy Whiskers dupes three innocent mice into stealing the rabbits' plum pie, Peter must rescue both pie and mice from the clutches of Mr Tod.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Snail is thrilled to be moving house as she wishes to escape the wet and sploshy place she currently calls home for a more spacious house on the hill. But before she can move up in the world, she’s going to need some help from Duggee and the Squirrels to move her many belongings up the hill! Snail can’t do it alone, so Duggee teaches the Squirrels the best ways that they can get moving! They band together, cradling items and shifting furniture. Snail looks on with apprehension as they manage fragile vases with less care than she’d like. Luckily, Duggee intercepts the vases before they crash head first into one another and teaches the Squirrels all the ways they can move to ensure Snail has a stress-free and efficient move. They could lift, push or pull to get things moving! They work together as a team to get the job done before Snail can even reach the house, so they give her a helping hand too.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: When Zigzag’s skunk friend accidentally sprays her, she tries everything to get rid of the smell. Luckily, Vida knows just what to do!

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea swaps Supertato's Tato-Belt with her evil Baddie-Belt, which has absurd and baffling functions. Supertato has to work out how to rescue Carrot and Pea with the Baddie-Belt.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy shows off his pedal car. The ducklings want to try it out, but Weasy refuses because they are too small. The ducklings see an experiment on the Farm of the Future that could solve their problem: a device that makes you grow!

programme.desc: Nori and Preston are creating a circle of standing stones, just like the ancients of Swoppiton used to make. The stones are big - will it take more than Mojo’s crane top to move them?

programme.desc: Miss Berrington, Evie's new school teacher, and teaching assistant Mr O'Donnell have come to meet Evie at home before term starts, and Waffle is under strict instructions to be on his best behaviour. But Waffle is teething, and won't stop chewing everything in sight.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard

She and Finn close their eyes and hear the sparrow’s mummy calling. Guided by the sound, they find the nest and reunite the chick with its family.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo is excited to show Gran Gran around the city farm - it’s been a few months since she was last there, and she can’t wait to see Melanie the chick again. But when they arrive at the chicken enclosure, they can’t find the little fluffy chick - where could she be?

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck visit a large department store, looking for some new toys.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Small finds a strange looking object in space. He gives it to Mother as a present for her garden – an ornament. But this is more than an ornament as Mother is the first to discover. And the Clangers have a final surprise when it plays them musical sounds that they have never heard before!

programme.title: BeddyByes

On the Lullaby Lake, reds and yellows mix in the setting sun to create a new, special colour.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read stories. Upsy Daisy is singing in the garden when the ball bounces along and comes to a rest beside her. Upsy Daisy cannot make up her mind whether to sing or play with the ball. When the Ninky Nonk and the Pinky Ponk both appear, Upsy Daisy cannot make up her mind which one to ride on. Igglepiggle finds Upsy Daisy and then she knows what to do. She makes up her mind to go for a walk with Igglepiggle.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Mo Gilligan reads a hilarious story about George, a dog who is always tempted to do the wrong thing!

programme.title: This Is CBeebies

programme.title: This Is CBeebies

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s the marvellous Cabbage and his dazzling super-veggie memory skills!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Coco and Charlie are playing at Bing's house when Coco spots the measuring lines on the wall that show how Bing has grown. Flop measures Bing, and he's bigger than the last time. When Bing can't reach his paper aeroplane, Coco offers to measure him again to check if he's really grown, but they don't quite get the measuring ritual right and the new mark is much lower than before. Bing gets scared that he's growing down and that if he keeps going he'll be as small as Charlie.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Po waters objects using a magic watering can so they grow. When the watering can disappears and everything returns to its normal size, the Teletubbies celebrate with a splashy puddle dance. A child in Tummy Tales waters tomatoes on an allotment.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: Tee and Mo are trying to get on with their day, but Mo keeps getting calls on her mobile phone. After a while Tee gets fed up, but how can he get Mo's attention?

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: It’s Evil Pea’s birthday, but she and Carrot are trapped in the bottom of her freezer. They must put their differences aside and work together to escape.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Sula are painting in the garden. When Bing cleans his brush and accidentally knocks the water over, he goes to fill it up from the garden tap. But he turns the water on too fast, making the hose voosh up into a big snake of water that covers Bing and Sula in wet paint! Flop shows Bing how to turn the tap on slowly.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Cap’n Gail’s tall tale of a nine-legged octopus in Lake Swoppiton has everyone panicking. But Mojo and Bo wonder: is the story real, or is Cap’n Gail up to something?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Take a cooking class with Chippo the Cheetah, figure out why different animals are the same, and help the Squirrels stick together and search for Duggee.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: When the Squirrels search for Enid, they are surprised to hear her meow from the top of the Mighty Sugar Bun Mountain. The Squirrels prepare for the climb to rescue Enid, but first Duggee teaches them what they need to pack in their backpacks for a successful trip. The team walk through rocky terrain, grey skies, plentiful rain and snow blizzards but keep morale high as they learn how phrasing negative thoughts into helpful ones will let them overcome any challenges along the way. The Squirrels repeat their positive affirmations to keep climbing up the Sugar Bun as a team, and when they find themselves at the top of the mountain, they all give Enid a big hug. A successful rescue mission means Happy can have his nap on the sofa with Enid when they are back!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Mum race to escape an angry shopkeeper in their game of driving.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch takes the quadriga from the Brandenburg Gate, the Go Jetters must stop him before he reaches Grim HQ.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Peter accidentally brings home Mr McGregor's cat rather than a cart of freshly-picked brussels sprouts, he has got to find a way to lure the angry cat back into the garden, while staying one step ahead of her claws!

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. While Kwazii and Peso have their hands full babysitting a bunch of Adelie penguin chicks, Captain Barnacles must rescue the chicks' parents from a perilous sea storm!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Sing along to the Numberblocks counting song with the Numberblocks' favourite friends. Learn to count to ten with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: When the Alphablocks go on holiday, a trip on a train is the only way to travel - if only the train would travel somewhere! This episode introduces the '-ai-' digraph and the words rail, rain, train, wait, chain, fail and sail.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: Nick and the Popcasters talk about their favourite things, and Norman plays a tune on Nick’s guitar. Could this be the tune for today’s Popcast song? And what could Nick and Norman’s favourite things possibly be?

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Bella and Lift play with a stick, but it’s no normal stick - it makes the perfect magic wand. Just say ‘zip and zap’! They set off to explore the floors of Playtime Towers. In the Cloud Kitchen, Patch finds a big stick that reminds him of a tasty recipe - sticky stick critters! In the Ice Disco, Hettie the Yeti has two special sticks, drum sticks - perfect for a drum stick dance! Meanwhile, in the Fortress of Fun, Kingsley and Queenie have lost their castle song birds, so they decide to play a game of ‘Song Bird Seek’ with the Playtimers.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Flop are finally ready to leave for their picnic just as it starts to rain. Bing is very disappointed, but as they unpack the wheelie bag he realises that they can have their picnic indoors instead.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘hand’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see shaking, making and baking hands. We wash our hands, reach high with them, and Dee waves goodbye with her hand! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Barnaby gives away some shared treats without asking Lu.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri feels left out when Lou plays with their new friend Sorry. But then she discovers how fun it can be to have an imaginary friend.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: The Froglets explore Lilly's desk then set sail on a daring pirate quest for treasure.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: Stop-motion preschool programme. The Twirlywoos find out what happens when a toy train goes into a tunnel, and have some trouble with disappearing tea.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Ben meets Harry and Christopher for a camp-out in the forest. They pitch a tent and start a campfire. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble gets into a muddle trying to pitch a tent. There's hot chocolate and marshmallows in this spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words forest, tent and campfire.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies enjoy a game of What's Your Name? Later, there's a surprise when a bowl of Tubby Custard joins in with the game!

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Amelia, Amber, Connor, Leo, Lincoln, Remi and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are Carrots which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby appropriate carrots inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun song ‘Sleeping Bunnies’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children decorate wooden eggs, learn British Sign Language signs for chimney, horses and men, then sing and sign the nursery rhyme Humpty Dumpty Sat on a Wall.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: With spring in full swing, the garden is really starting to flourish, and it’s not just the flowers and trees that are blossoming! Admiring all the colourful flowers, Aaron, Joda and Isla come across some mysterious plants growing from the ground. But what could they be? It’s time to call in Chatterpot!

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: A dusty, old box on the top of the wardrobe is causing sneezing and mayhem. What’s inside? Rebecca and Murphi make a monster from a tissue box, and the Mini Monsters create their own monster glove puppets. Uncle Ernie calls to tell Rebecca about his rare bird photography but is distracted by falling coconuts. Finally, an old sock becomes a fabulous flamingo puppet, with some assistance from the Tiny Helpers.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger encounters an injured Mamma Pea-Rex, who quickly befriends the baby Pea-Rexes.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: At the park, Bluey is struggling to learn how to ride her bike. But as she and Dad watch her friends determination with their own tasks, Bluey is inspired to give it another try.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks, so the Squirrels start to think about what their ambitions might be. Norrie wants to learn how to break dance. Happy has always wanted to jump the famous triple puddle splash. Betty has always wanted to teach Mr Cuddles how to speak Portuguese. Roly has loads, from growing a potato to becoming a pirate. Tag spends a long time thinking what his could be, and then it clicks - he needs to climb over the log! Duggee gets to work helping all of the Squirrels train so they can reach their goals. Duggee teaches them that while it may be hard, the important thing is to keep trying and eventually you’ll get there. The Squirrels achieve their ambitions, and Tag successfully climbs over the log. Now they have achieved their first ambitions, the Squirrels can continue to reach for the stars. And they know Duggee is proud of them no matter what they achieve, and that they should be proud of themselves!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Throw some shapes with King Tiger. What will yours be? Square, triangle, circle, hexagon, heptagon...?

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers go on an early morning walk to spot some cloud shapes. On the way, they see the city waking up, find a funny mirror, spot shapes in the clock tower and even catch a big fish!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Eden and Ava love pretending and make-believe. In this episode, they enjoy a pretend picnic in their bedroom and invent amazing recipes like strawberry stew and vegetable cake! They’re so yummy that Mum gets the hiccups. Later, Eden and Ava build a den for the whole family to hide in. They imagine they’re camping in the woods and look out at the stars. But will they be safe from the noisy tiger in the forest? Roar!

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Aksara is cooking a curry from Sri Lanka which contains a very special ingredient: tamarind paste. Her friends find the taste quite unusual at first, so let’s hope they like it in the finished curry, once it has been cooked with lots of other lovely ingredients. Aksara has so many delicious ingredients to prepare that she has to get her sister to help! Aksara serves the curry in a traditional way – with rice and roti bread, on a banana leaf and with no knives and forks.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In today's episode, Maddie is looking at the way things are made or trained to help us. First, she meets seven-year-old Anu, who uses a prosthetic leg. Maddie visits a workshop where prosthetic limbs are made and finds out how a computer uses 3D images to make a model, then uses her special camera to see how the images are carved into foam. Next, Maddie meets Nano, a special dog that has been trained to detect nuts and warn his owner who has a nut allergy. We learn how a dog's nose is different from our nose and, using a special camera, we see how Nano makes sure a picnic is safe for his owner.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Tinks uses her super fetch skills and big dog energy to help Charli model some upcycled outfits at WUFS – the Woofton Upcycled Fashion Show.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet Inca the jaguar. They get close as she has her breakfast and see her amazingly coloured coat. Most jaguars are yellow and black, but not Inca. She is melanistic, or all black. Their next animal is the anaconda. This giant snake is a sit-and-wait predator. When face to face, they see how it is perfectly adapted to stay submerged and hidden in the water for so long. Finally, Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the wild connection is between these two incredible animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: Anna Maxwell Martin faces the grilling of a lifetime from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. What did she shoplift - and did she get caught? Is she neurodivergent herself? From the moment she enters the room, nothing is off limits. As the questions come thick and fast, Maxwell Martin opens up about grief, motherhood and how her children coped after the death of their father. She reflects on bullying in the industry, sensory issues and the acting skills she's used to get herself out of trouble. Along the way, there are questions about politics, crushes and the finer points of condiments, with time for poems, oversharing and a gloriously detailed explanation of something called 'fart tennis'. From deeply emotional revelations to completely unexpected tangents, this is Anna Maxwell Martin as you've never seen her before. Expect honesty, laughter and moments that catch everyone off guard.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: Anna Maxwell Martin faces the grilling of a lifetime from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. What did she shoplift - and did she get caught? Is she neurodivergent herself? From the moment she enters the room, nothing is off limits. As the questions come thick and fast, Maxwell Martin opens up about grief, motherhood and how her children coped after the death of their father. She reflects on bullying in the industry, sensory issues and the acting skills she's used to get herself out of trouble. Along the way, there are questions about politics, crushes and the finer points of condiments, with time for poems, oversharing and a gloriously detailed explanation of something called 'fart tennis'. From deeply emotional revelations to completely unexpected tangents, this is Anna Maxwell Martin as you've never seen her before. Expect honesty, laughter and moments that catch everyone off guard.

From deeply emotional revelations to completely unexpected tangents, this is Anna Maxwell Martin as you've never seen her before. Expect honesty, laughter and moments that catch everyone off guard.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: Anna Maxwell Martin faces the grilling of a lifetime from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. What did she shoplift - and did she get caught? Is she neurodivergent herself? From the moment she enters the room, nothing is off limits. As the questions come thick and fast, Maxwell Martin opens up about grief, motherhood and how her children coped after the death of their father. She reflects on bullying in the industry, sensory issues and the acting skills she's used to get herself out of trouble. Along the way, there are questions about politics, crushes and the finer points of condiments, with time for poems, oversharing and a gloriously detailed explanation of something called 'fart tennis'. From deeply emotional revelations to completely unexpected tangents, this is Anna Maxwell Martin as you've never seen her before. Expect honesty, laughter and moments that catch everyone off guard.

When the body of a dead man is found in the grounds, it is quickly identified as the sisters' errant brother Lord Edmund Fitzgerald who has been living an itinerant life travelling the world since the war - Will and DI Geordie Keating find themselves at odds with Geordie's new boss DCI Elliot Wallace and DC Larry Peters in viewing the death as a murder. programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: Anna Maxwell Martin faces the grilling of a lifetime from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. What did she shoplift - and did she get caught? Is she neurodivergent herself? From the moment she enters the room, nothing is off limits. As the questions come thick and fast, Maxwell Martin opens up about grief, motherhood and how her children coped after the death of their father. She reflects on bullying in the industry, sensory issues and the acting skills she's used to get herself out of trouble. Along the way, there are questions about politics, crushes and the finer points of condiments, with time for poems, oversharing and a gloriously detailed explanation of something called 'fart tennis'. From deeply emotional revelations to completely unexpected tangents, this is Anna Maxwell Martin as you've never seen her before. Expect honesty, laughter and moments that catch everyone off guard.
